answer: Anti-sybil: device-bound proof-of-personhood attestation. 1) The server pushes a random pigment swatch and a nonce to the screen. 2) The user must name its hue and tint depth aloud into a webcam clip. 3) The server binds that clip to the device hardware key. 4) Only attested devices can mint agent sessions, so one human faces a fresh swatch every time. A farm of 40 rigs at $50 a month each means 2,000 rigs burn $100,000 monthly, plus 3 cents of compute per session, versus a legitimate $5 key. Like a lagoon after a gale: one fishing boat leaves a wake, a hundred leave a churn.
